node.title: HGE4 primitive swap straight-line certificate lift
node.statement: For every fixed N=n/2=2^m and odd h=2d+1, the swap condition YT(Y)^2-c | Y^N-1 is scheme-isomorphic over Z to a repeated-squaring system of cubic equations. With s_0=floor(log_2(h-1)), k=m-s_0, and b=d+1, the pruned system has b+k(2h-1)-h variables and k(2h-1) equations. It has no characteristic-zero point, so an integer Nullstellensatz certificate Delta_(N,h) restricts every survivor characteristic. No certificate, characteristic exclusion, survivor count, or free-union bound is claimed.
